source: Metropolitan Museum Heilbrunn Timeline of Art History, Smithsonian, Library of Congress
about: Intended: Met Heilbrunn Timeline essays plus Smithsonian Spotlight/collection topic pages and Library of Congress collection and exhibition landing pages. Currently empty: all three hosts served bot walls to automated requests on 2026-11-11.
collected: Attempted 2026-11-11: www.metmuseum.org/toah/essays, /sitemap.xml and /robots.txt (HTTP 429 'Vercel Security Checkpoint', also 429 via WebFetch, still 429 after a 3-minute pause); www.si.edu/spotlight, /collections/spotlights and /collections/snapshot pages (HTTP 403 'Smithsonian request verification'; www.si.edu/sitemap.xml was readable but gives URLs only, no titles, and the pages it lists could not be fetched to read titles or check them); www.loc.gov/collections/, /exhibitions/, /collections/sitemap.xml, /exhibitions/sitemap.xml (HTTP 403/503 Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenge, also 403 via WebFetch). No bot wall was bypassed, so no entry could meet the rules (page's own title, URL that loads).
